data.name: Channu
data.long_meaning: The name Channu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chandra’, which means moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often personified as the god Chandrama, who is a primary deity and is considered the ruler of the night. Thus, the name Channu is an expression of reverence and devotion towards the lunar deity.

The name Channu is often used as a term of endearment towards children, symbolizing their pure, innocent souls that are associated with the calming and soothing influence of the moon.

The name Channu is a reminder of the importance of staying connected to these divine qualities, and of the power of the moon to bring clarity, wisdom, and a sense of calm and inner peace to one’s life.
